rows.en: Yamato: "...Well, we're here, but..."
Touya: "It's awfully quiet..."
Yamato: "Huh? It's Liebhofen."
Sisk: "How are things over there?"
Touya: "See for yourself. Something's wrong.
More importantly, what happened to them?"
Miyasco: "Right after you and the others pulled out, Touya,
they went berserk... And exploded."
Touya: "Huh? What the hell?"
Sisk: "Anyway, secure that area for now.
We'll head over as soon as we've picked everyone up."
Touya: "Understood. See you in a bit."
Yamato: "...?"
Touya: "What is it?"
Yamato: "...Some people have come out all tied up...
Oh! Isn't that Derock?"
Touya: "I was wondering where he'd gone...
Did he infiltrate the place all by himself?"
Yamato: "To get inside and capture the people involved
in such a short time..."
Touya: "Anyway, it looks like we've accomplished our goal..."
Touya: "...What's going on?"
Ai: "Don't ask me."
Kururu: "Hey, who are those people all tied up?"
Clovis: "...They're probably involved with 'Code 3.'
Look. The big guy's standing there looking pleased with himself."
Aurelie: "I was wondering where he'd gone...
I never imagined he'd infiltrated the place."
Xiujian: "To infiltrate the place and capture the people involved
in so little time..."
Touya: "Anyway, we accomplished our goal.
Let's pick up Derock and get back to Liebhofen."
Ai: "Right..."
Derock: "...And that concludes the tale of my exploits."
Ai: "In short, the research facility was a front.
They were also researching food, and those researchers
didn't know anything about 'Code 3.'
So you explained things to them, got their help,
and rounded everyone up at once. That's it, right?!
You went on about so much pointless stuff!"
Xiujian: "I'm surprised the researchers accepted Derock's story
so readily, but his work was impressive.
It seems he really is good at this."
Derock: "Heh. I can do most things.
I simply don't do them.
I'm made differently from ordinary people."
Ai: "...He actually did it, so he's proved it...
But somehow it really gets on my nerves..."
Sisk: "H-Hey. The people at the institute
want me to ask Derock what they should do
from now on..."
Aurelie: "...Just what did you do to them?"
Derock: "I didn't do anything.
They need a leader like me.
I'll go have a word and calm them down."
Ai: "Something is wrong here...
The world's gone mad..."
Clovis: "...Well. We've secured the evidence
and finished erasing the data."
Ai: "Hey, are we really okay with handing those people over?
What if they start it up again...?"
Xiujian: "It should be fine.
The researchers were disgusted by 'Code 3' too."
Aurelie: "It's only the people at the top who lack any decency.
Besides, we've erased most of the data.
Even if they tried to carry on underground, it'd take time.
We should be able to do plenty in the meantime."
Sisk: "H-Hey, there's no need to linger in Zigrim territory
and provoke them. Shall we join up with Celica?"
Touya: "Yeah. Things here should be fine now."
Miyasco: "..."
Sisk: "R-Right! Let's hurry!"
Miyasco: "...Please wait.
There's something I need to tell all of you."
Sisk: "Miyasco..."
Miyasco: "Thank you for being considerate.
But after all this, I can't keep it hidden...
Sisk, I want you to hear it too.
About that insane project, 'Code 3,'
and about me..."
Miyasco: "...The human enhancement project, commonly known as 'Code 3.'
The plan was to take humans created through genetic engineering,
then enhance them artificially with drugs, so that perfect soldiers
could be created.
I too was born and raised in a research institute..."
Sisk: "What?!"
Miyasco: "That inhumane project, which ignored all ethical principles,
was immediately halted by the previous president
and scrapped.
The direct cause was the test subjects going berserk. Just five of them
destroyed two battalions. But all of these
events were erased in secret and buried
in the shadows of history...
I was one of those five.
Major Rest, who was serving on border patrol duty at the time,
rescued me. Through his kindness, the Kingdom of Agarthia
took me in, and I finally reached the point
where I could live an ordinary life."
Clovis: "...I see.
So this time they're using drugs..."
Miyasco: "Yes. That drug probably provides a temporary
enhancement at the cost of putting a heavy strain on the nerves and mind.
It truly treats people as disposable tools."
Ai: "...That's the lowest, most despicable method."
Miyasco: "...I'm sorry I've kept quiet all this time.
The truth is, I was afraid...
Afraid I'd have to leave you all if the truth came out..."
Sisk: "I see... Now I understand
why you've seemed so out of sorts."
Miyasco: "...I'm sorry, Sisk."
Sisk: "It's fine. However you came into this world, Miyasco,
you're still Miyasco.
That doesn't change the fact that we're friends."
Miyasco: "Sisk..."
Sisk: "I told you, didn't I?
'Real friends never betray each other.'"
Miyasco: "Sisk... Thank you..."
Xiujian: "...Thank you for telling us.
You've had a hard time, and from now on too..."
Miyasco: "No. I have companions I can rely on,
and a true friend."
Ai: "Well said!
That's right. We're comrades.
We always have been, and always will be."
Clovis: "Yeah, of course.
...Miyasco, do Celica and the others know about this?"
Miyasco: "No... But I've asked Major Rest.
I think he's explaining it to them right about now..."
Clovis: "I see. Well, I'm sure they feel the same
as we do. Let's act just like always when we meet up.
If you worry about it, Miyasco, everyone else will feel they have to be careful too."
Miyasco: "Y-Yes!"
Captain Roa: "?!"
Sisk: "Huh? What's this?!
Someone's cutting into our Class One circuit!"
Reamond: "...Forgive this sudden breach of courtesy.
But we're no longer in a position
to worry about appearances."
Miyasco: "Oh... Reamond..."
Clovis: "...What happened?"
Reamond: "...We've been defeated."
Touya: "What?!"
Ai: "...Seriously?"
Reamond: "Only I and
Lieutenant Colonel Fores Mishual made it out of the battle.
And the colonel is wounded and unconscious..."
Xiujian: "What happened to General Growster?
Surely he wasn't... Killed in action...?"
Reamond: "I don't know. But His Excellency stayed behind in Baresios,
and that let us escape...
At this rate, the president will get everything he wants.
I know this is a selfish request, but please help us.
This concerns the future of Zigrim... No, the world.
I'll make sure your innocence is proved."
Ai: "Help you do what, exactly?"
Reamond: "Launch an assault on the presidential residence."
Clovis: "...That's a bold request."
Reamond: "I know that well.
But we have no other option left.
Fortunately, it's away from the city..."
Aurelie: "It's reckless, but we really don't have time to hesitate.
And it might be our best chance to take out the head."
Clovis: "We ought to join Celica and the others,
but there's no time for that either.
Captain, let's head there with just our group."
Captain Roa: "Hmm!"
Ai: "Then it's settled."
Touya: "We're heading to the residence now. What's your plan?"
Reamond: "I'll head there too as soon as I'm ready.
I'll use the confusion while you subdue the defenders to enter the residence
and take the president into custody."
Touya: "So we'll be the decoys outside, huh?
But the timing's going to be tricky, right?
What will you do about that?"
Reamond: "I'll send you my plan later.
I'll also give you a signal before I begin,
so please start moving after that."
Touya: "That's fine, but..."
Xiujian: "Will you be all right alone?"
Reamond: "I was made to do that sort of thing too.
...I'm counting on you, then."
Ai: "Made...?"
Miyasco: "He was a 'test subject,' just like me.
And to stop 'Code 3,'
he intends to stake everything."
Ai: "Let's go! Let's slap the bastard
who came up with this idiotic plan across the face!"
Captain Roa: "Hmm!"
Baren: "...Liebhofen, launch!"
Tix: "...Huh? Why am I here...?
Ahead is the Chamber of Sealing... The place that protects the 'Guardian'..."
Tix: "...What is this? It feels familiar...
But something's a little different..."
Tix: "Is that... An Armored Mech...?
No, it's something else..."
Tix: "!! ...Wh-Who's there?!"
?????: "...Hello. It's been a while, Tix."
Tix: "N-No way... Big Brother Rayfon?"
